aggregation.diagnostics: no ratio, no winner; the Zinc-only verify_e2e is reported as a diagnostic without a cross-system ratio
per_metric_fields: process_estimates (six per system: block, median, lower, upper as decimal strings)
same_block_ratios (six reduced pairs; null for a historical_exploratory baseline)
ratio (reduced pair; null for a historical_exploratory baseline)
conservative_intervals (six [lower, upper] reduced pairs; null for a historical_exploratory baseline)
winner (A|B|inconclusive; null for a historical_exploratory baseline)
aggregation.winner_rule: A iff upper < 1 in all six blocks; B iff lower > 1 in all six blocks; otherwise inconclusive; equality is inconclusive

limber.placeholder_note: limber_wire_id is a placeholder pinned by the Zinc+ publisher until limber publishes its P0-D wire id; re-pin it (and this schema id) when the limber amendment lands
limber.security_accounting_id: the compiled id must equal the SHA-256 of the archived security-accounting copy

approved_capability_tuples.limber_rule: a limber archive whose compiled (protocol_wire_id, prime_sampler_id, benchmark_coins_id) is not this tuple, whose P0-D audit is absent or incomplete, whose rayon_threads_asserted is not 1 or whose sampled-prime count disagrees with its audit is classified historical_exploratory (all limber roles together); a legacy sampler id is never quantified
approved_capability_tuples.zinc_rule: exactly these two tuples; FQ rows require the v3 tuple; the compiled transcript_domain_separator must equal the copied security file's transcript.domain_separator; any other tuple is fatal

baseline_class.hardened: the approved capability tuple, security-accounting id and (limber) P0-D audit are present and validated; the row may carry ratios, a winner, the shared tuning epoch and a security row
baseline_class.historical_exploratory: a limber archive without the hardened tuple: its process estimates are retained as exploratory measurements, reported without ratio, winner, shared tuning epoch or security row (plan lines 86-92)
baseline_class.zinc: the Zinc row is always hardened; an unapproved Zinc tuple is fatal

cross_archive_compatibility.build_profile_rule: when build-profile.json is archived, the listed keys (present or absent consistently) must be equal across roles; when it carries log_sha256 the archived build-profile.log must hash to it
cross_archive_compatibility.limber_extra: limber roles additionally require preflight.rayon_threads_asserted = 1, the benchmark-coins policy id and the P0-D audit presence fields (see limber_archive_fields)

permitted_differences.backend: limber backend (hyrax|brakedown) versus the Zinc variant/FL
permitted_differences.comparison_key: binds the group-local tuning IDs and protocol-specific inputs
permitted_differences.dependencies: protocol-specific dependency graphs (dependencies.criterion, the shared harness version, is required-equal)
permitted_differences.dimensions: limber combined-circuit dimensions {log_cons, log_vars} versus Zinc num_vars
permitted_differences.dimensions_by_candidate: limber sweep dimensions per candidate k
permitted_differences.k: limber backend-specific k versus the Zinc int-PP shape
permitted_differences.tuning: independently validated group-local tuning and epoch IDs
permitted_differences.tuning_epoch_id: independently validated group-local tuning and epoch IDs
permitted_differences.tuning_id: independently validated group-local tuning and epoch IDs
permitted_differences.workload.backend: limber backend versus the Zinc variant
permitted_differences.workload.k: limber k versus the Zinc shape

cross_archive_compatibility.scope: the three roles' run-config.json documents are flattened to dotted key paths and compared pairwise; required_values are checked per role; required_equal paths must exist in every role and be equal; a differing path is accepted only when it is a permitted_differences prefix; any other difference is fatal and reported with the key path

dependency_sources.output: dependency_source_ids_by_role (null when the role archives no document)
dependency_sources.revalidation: the copied document is canonical JSON, contains no dependency_source_id, records only relative ASCII audit paths under the <SOURCE>/<CARGO_HOME>/<METADATA_TARGET> tokens, and its exact-byte SHA-256 equals every recorded DEPENDENCY_SOURCE_ID of that role (run-config ids.dependency_source_id / build.dependency_source_id, build-profile.json dependency_source_id); with poseidon_build_env importable and --cargo-home given the registry/git proofs are rehashed through rehash_dependency_closure

failure_error_entry_fields: path (optional: the file or key path the error names)

failure_semantics.durability_unconfirmed: a post-rename parent-fsync error is reported as durability-unconfirmed (the final directory may be visible; nothing is claimed about staging)
failure_semantics.errors: comparison-failure.json errors are bytewise-sorted structured records {stage, code, path?} without host exception prose (stderr only)
failure_semantics.no_output: an error before exclusive staging creation (including an existing staging or failure name) writes nothing
failure_semantics.sealed_failure: only a validation failure (stages session, eligibility, capability, compat, tuning, dependency, timing, size, security) seals comparison-failed-<request12>
failure_semantics.staging_left: a success-name collision, a store import error, a sealing or pre-rename durability error leaves the unrenamed staging directory and never creates a failure artifact

inputs.disjointness: every pair among the publisher source checkout, the session, the zinc tuning store, the limber tuning store, the comparison store (and its objects tree) and the output parent has disjoint canonical real paths (neither equal, containing nor contained); checked before any staging mkdir or store import
inputs.path_rules: absolute, pre-existing, symlink-free directories; the comparison store and output parent writable; a symlink anywhere below an input or store object is rejected
inputs.q: positive canonical base-10 integer string: ASCII ^[1-9][0-9]*$ (no sign, no leading zero)
inputs.session: one finalized three-system session envelope (root session-manifest first)

preflight.prime_audit: {complete: true, prime_sampler_id, invocations, records: [...]} (P0-D audit presence: complete and invocations == len(records) == s_limber)
preflight.rayon_threads_asserted: the thread count the bench asserted at runtime; must be 1

limber_archive_fields.proof_size: proof-size.json with metric_kind mixed_payload_estimate (or wire_bytes), comparison_key and verified = true

run_config.ids.benchmark_coins_policy.id: the benchmark-coins policy id; must equal benchmark_coins_id

limber_archive_fields.security_file: security-accounting-v1.json under the same expression grammar (any schema id string; variants keyed by backend or a single variant), mandatory sampler_union event

object_store.import: a missing object is copied to the exclusively created sibling .<sha256>.<first-12-request-id-hex>.staging, recursively rehashed and verified as its kind, fsynced bottom-up and no-replace renamed; objects/ is fsynced after the rename
object_store.layout: <COMPARISON_STORE>/objects/<sha256>/ named by the validated root session-manifest digest, origin manifest digest, tuning-bundle exact-byte digest (tuning-bundle.json) or PUBLISHER_ID (publisher-source.json)
object_store.reuse: an existing object, including one that wins a rename race (RenameRefused), is reused only after the same full rehash/verification, bottom-up fsync of every file and directory and fsync of objects/; any mismatch or sync failure is fatal and never overwritten
object_store.validate: --validate resolves the session, both tuning bundles, both origins and the publisher source from objects/ by the digests recorded in comparison.json, verifies each, hashes the artifact's own publisher-source.json and comparison-schema-v2.json against the manifest ids, recomputes comparison.json and re-renders comparison.md/comparison.csv byte for byte

permitted_cross_system_differences: protocol-specific dependency graphs and validated DEPENDENCY_SOURCE_IDs (not the shared Criterion harness version)
approved protocol-specific wire/sampler/common-lift capability tuples and security-accounting IDs/event sets
independently validated group-local tuning and epoch IDs

publisher_source.closure: bytewise-sorted [path, size, sha256] of scripts/publish_poseidon_comparison.py and every local module it imports (poseidon_common, artifact_fs, poseidon_runner, poseidon_security, poseidon_tune1, and poseidon_build_env when present)
publisher_source.commit: the HEAD commit of the clean publisher checkout (independent-walk snapshot: every path below the checkout except the verified root .git directory must be a tracked regular file with the tree's mode and blob; ignored and untracked entries are rejected)
publisher_source.id: PUBLISHER_ID = SHA-256 of the exact file bytes (the file does not contain its own id)
publisher_source.python_version: the stripped stdout of a fresh `python3 -B -VV` subprocess of the selected interpreter

renderings: comparison.md and comparison.csv are deterministic renderings of comparison.json plus the detached comparison_id; validators recompute comparison.json from the digest-resolved inputs and Q, then rerender both byte-for-byte

request.id: request_id = SHA-256 of the exact request bytes

required_equal: byte-identical session config/result files and detached digests
normalized bench profile/flags (rustflags -C target-cpu=native, profile bench, profile block hash)
criterion 0.7.0 with the shared feature set and settings
timing_schema_id and aligned group boundaries (byte-identical timing-schema copies, primary order prove_e2e, verify_core)
recorded literal non-native predicate (Zinc): owned sampled moduli recomputed against the three width-extended targets

result_class.headline: qz/FL4/H=10 only
result_class.rule: renderers keep the classes separate and never select an experimental winner as the answer to the primary benchmark question

security_expression.cross_system: no cross-system security winner is ever emitted (cross_system_security_winner = null)
security_expression.expanded_trees: each quantified event's expression is mul[indicator, multiplicity, bound] with every symbol (degrees, challenge counts, families, s, q_star, mu, B, T_MAX, ...) replaced by its exact int/rat/power-of-two node so that the tree evaluates with an empty environment; total_expression is min_one(mul[Q, add[expressions]])
forbidden: JSON numbers anywhere in the security file
security_expression.grammar_source: specs/poseidon/security-accounting-v1.json (expression_grammar); limber's file uses the same grammar under its own schema id

nodes.pow: {"pow": [base, exponent]}: exact power, integer-valued exponent (negative allowed = exact rational)
nodes.symbol: {"symbol": "<name>"}: a named symbol from the security file symbols table

security_expression.q_star: QZ: the recorded sampled q_0 of the Zinc preflight (checked section); FQ: p_BN254; limber: the run's shared-challenge modulus when its file declares q_star
security_expression.symbolic_pi_b: schema-v1 symbolic prime_population(B) is display-only and never used in the total
security_expression.symbols: resolved from the security file symbols table: constants carry a value; run_parameter symbols come from the archive (fl, s = count of preflight.checked.sampled_moduli, q_star, num_vars, max_degree, mu); derived symbols (B, d_qz, d_lift, k, p_max) are computed per their definition; Q is the publisher input
security_expression.total_rule: min(1, Q * sum over events of indicator * multiplicity * bound); an event with per is counted once per item of the variant count it names; any unquantified event makes the total null and security_bound_quantified false; a historical_exploratory limber role has a null security row
security_expression.unquantified_marker: the literal string "unquantified" in place of a bound expression; the record carries status = unquantified and a reason

size_row.component_breakdown: reported per system, never summed into one line
size_row.limber: commitments + eval_arg canonical bytes + analytical sumcheck remainder (no serialization) = mixed_payload_estimate
size_row.rule: ratio, percent delta and winner are null while either side reports mixed_payload_estimate; an exact wire comparison requires metric_kind = wire_bytes on both sides
size_row.zincplus: proof_wire_bytes (complete canonical encoding including the outer length prefix); zstd-22 size reported for Zinc+ only

tuning_origins.historical: a historical_exploratory limber role has no shared epoch: its origin is not resolved and its tuning ids are reported null
tuning_origins.rule: each role's tuning-bundle.json (exact-byte digest = tuning_epoch_id, equal to the manifest's) names one group whose origin archive is resolved by manifest digest from the role's tuning store, fully verified (index, every payload, exact sweep file set, durability confirmation), tuning-eligible, with tuning-result.json re-executed and its digest equal to tuning_id; the bundle's source_sha, lockfile_sha256 and (when present) dependency_source_id must equal the origin run-config's
